title: Thread
description: Your Up Next queue strung on one elastic thread, every cover a bead riding it — swipe a song off and the thread twangs, sending a wave down the rows below while the gap closes and the counts roll. Hold a row to lift it and the thread stretches after it; let go and it plucks a note that rises as the queue gets shorter.
intent: A real queue list where removing or reordering a song has a physical, audible consequence travelling through every other row.
